name: Road Trip West
tagline: One Toyota car carries you from Kawasaki via Daikoku, Enoshima, the Hakone Turnpike and Fuji to Osaka and the Suzuka track, and a second car takes you to the Rusutsu drift course, three ski areas, Otaru and Asahiyama.
summary: Three Tokyo nights with a full anime day and the Girls Band Cry walk, then a Toyota car from Kawasaki (Jan 21) to Namba (Jan 24): Daikoku, Enoshima and the Slam Dunk crossing, the Turnpike, Eva's Lake Ashi, Gotemba and a Fuji-view villa. On the long Fuji → Osaka day you drive to the Namba base, see the Nara hill fire by train, and drive to Suzuka on Sunday before you return the car. One Kansai base (4 nights) covers Kyoto, Kobe and Osaka. In Hokkaido (5 nights) a second car links the Rusutsu drift course, Rusutsu, Annupuri and Hirafu skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki), Otaru, Sapporo and Asahiyama. You fly back to Tokyo on Feb 1 because it is cheaper for both return flights. You travel together every hour of the trip, and every meal is planned.

who.pegasis: In: Daikoku (he drives, Thu), Hakone Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (plain shopping; he buys a suitcase for the way home), Suzuka EV kart, Rusutsu snow drift (he drives), 3 ski days (Rusutsu, Annupuri, Hirafu; he teaches Aoki), Asahiyama penguins, Daruma, GARAKU, Moiwa, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, SHELTER live show, Maidreamin (Akihabara lunch, Osaka lunch), Ikebukuro goods, Nara fire, Isetan half-price dinner (Feb 1), City Hall view, Omoide Yokocho (first night), Narita bus, and the car road west. No clothes shopping: he brings his own winter clothes. Out: Onuma (about 4 h each way from Niseko); the Toyota museums in Nagoya (not on the route). You travel together all the time: he joins Suga Shrine (15 min), Enoshima (morning), Cup Noodles and Chinatown (Jan 21), and Aoki's Kyoto temple and Sabbat day (Jan 25, with a 07:45 start instead of dawn) as the fair trade for the Turnpike, Gotemba and the drift day.
who.aoki: In: Suga stairs, Akihabara, ZEST, maid cafés (Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo), Nakano, Shimokitazawa and SHELTER, Girls Band Cry Kawasaki + Yako + Hachiko, Yokohama Chinatown and Cup Noodles (together, after the car pick-up), Daikoku with Tatsumi and Umihotaru, Enoshima and the Slam Dunk crossing, Evangelion's Lake Ashi, Lake Kawaguchi, the Hanz Fuji-view villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Suzuka, Nara, Fushimi Inari (09:10, not dawn) and Kinkakuji, Sabbat (Kyoto arcade, Kobe café, Osaka mall), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Rusutsu drift ride (back seat + pro ride), Niseko skiing on beginner runs (Pegasis teaches him, no ski school), Daruma, Moiwa, Shibuya Sky, Shibuya PARCO, Ikebukuro, City Hall view, Omoide Yokocho. Out: Kyoto Concert Hall photo (Sabbat school; dropped for time), Fuji Motorsports Museum (no time; Pegasis 'not interested'), Fujiten ski (Niseko is the better ski), Numazu (adds 1 h 30 to the long drive), Toyota museums (Nagoya off route), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Nissan Crossing, Budokan GBC scene.

cost.hotels: ≈ ¥176,000 per person. Super Hotel Shinjuku 4 nights ≈ ¥67,400 for two + car park ¥2,000 (Jan 21); Hanz villa half board ≈ ¥54,000 (Rakuten, Jan 22); Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba 4 nights ≈ ¥107,500 (Jalan) + parking ¥2,500; STAY RESORT NISEKO 3 nights ¥81,360 (Jalan, twin); Premier Hotel Nakajima Koen Sapporo 2 nights ¥35,800 (Jalan, twin) + parking ¥1,500.
cost.activities: Pegasis ≈ ¥145,000 (Rusutsu intro drive ¥31,000 + Subaru pro ride ¥17,000, Rhythm 3-day skis + jacket + pants + helmet ≈ ¥39,000 if booked online by Oct 31, goggles + gloves bought at Rhythm ≈ ¥6,000, lift tickets Rusutsu 5 h ¥11,600 + Annupuri ¥7,800 + Hirafu ¥11,800, Suzuka, SHELTER, maid cafés, zoo, Moiwa, Shibuya Sky). Aoki ≈ ¥110,000 (Rusutsu back seat ¥10,000 + pro ride ¥17,000, rental ≈ ¥25,000, goggles + gloves ≈ ¥6,000, the same 3 lift tickets ¥31,200, no ski school, the same sights). To save ¥27,000, Aoki can only watch the drift (¥4,500 companion fee).
cost.total: ≈ ¥464,000 Pegasis / ≈ ¥429,000 Aoki, plus food ≈ ¥85,000 per person (all 45 meals are in the plan: about ¥5,500–6,000 a day; the Dormy Inn breakfasts ¥2,500 each are the biggest part — a konbini breakfast saves about ¥8,000), excl. international flights. Pegasis's suitcase for the way home: about ¥15,000 extra.

Sapporo → Tokyo: Skymark BC 710 New Chitose → Haneda Mon Feb 1 10:35 → 12:20, ¥11,750 per person, bag included (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026). Ending in Sapporo instead would cost Pegasis CA$1,247 open-jaw and Aoki CA$612–750 from New Chitose, so Tokyo is cheaper for both.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 14:30 → Sun Jan 24 about 16:45 at Namba Terminal

info.label: One-way fee
info.value: Kawasaki-ekimae Nishiguchi → Namba Terminal ¥37,950 (Toyota one-way simulator, car class, Sep 26, 2026)

places.ja: 江島神社・片瀬江ノ島駅

info.label: Parking
info.value: Enoshima island prefectural car parks (about ¥1,000–1,500/half day)

tips: Clear winter mornings show Mt Fuji across Sagami Bay.

tips: Stay on the sidewalk and follow the guards. Do not stand in the road.

tips: Eva goods and collabs change often; there was no fixed Eva shop confirmed for 2027.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: A mountain pass on Route 138 with a famous full view of Mt Fuji over Gotemba.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: Big outlet mall with a Fuji view. A shopping stop on the road, and where Pegasis buys the suitcase for the way home.

info.label: Outdoor shops
info.value: The North Face, Columbia, Salomon, Mammut, Descente, Timberland, UGG, Coleman (official shop list)

tips: Tax-free from ¥5,000 per shop: bring your passport.
Leave by 15:45 to reach the villa before dark (sunset about 16:50).

places.ja: HANZ OUTDOOR RESORT 河口湖
places.blurb: Fuji-view villa (glamping style) in the forest south of Lake Kawaguchi, with its own indoor hot tub. The one special night of the trip, and Aoki's pick.

info.label: Price
info.value: Half board (Villa C, dinner + breakfast) ¥53,600 for two (Rakuten, Sep 2026); Expedia showed about CA$401 earlier

tips: Book half board: there is little food nearby in the evening. Dinner is a BBQ or Dutch-oven course at the villa; the breakfast kit comes 07:00–09:00.
You leave at 06:05 for the sunrise, before the breakfast kit: buy breakfast at the Lawson on the way.
Nobody has to use the hot tub; the room and the Fuji view are the reason to stay.
Last check-in is 17:00 and you arrive about 16:40: tell the hotel your arrival time, and phone if you leave Gotemba after 15:45.

places.en: Lake Kawaguchi north shore, Oishi Park
places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: The classic Fuji-over-the-lake view from the north shore. At sunrise Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold at dawn (−5 °C or less): hat and gloves.

places.ja: 浩庵キャンプ場
places.blurb: Where Rin camps in Yuru Camp episode 1, and the Fuji view on the old ¥1,000 note. Early morning the lake is calm.

info.label: Entry

tips: Bring gloves: it is often −5 °C here at 07:00.

places.ja: 天然温泉 夕霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんば

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin ¥22,000–32,000 per night (Jalan, Sep 2026): Sat Jan 23 ¥32,000, Jan 24 ¥22,000, Jan 25 ¥26,500, Jan 26 ¥27,000 ≈ ¥107,500 for two; a double is about ¥3,000 less per night

info.label: Address

places.ja: 東大寺

places.ja: Rhythm ヒラフ店

tips: Book Aoki's skis at the same time (and a jacket and pants if Aoki does not bring them).

places.ja: STAY RESORT NISEKO（ステイリゾートニセコ）

info.label: Parking
info.value: Free, a short walk from the hotel (map at the desk)

tips: Check in first and unload the bags, then park the car in the hotel's car park.
Why not Hotel 3M: it had only smoking twins left for these dates.

places.ja: 山本食堂
places.blurb: An old family diner: katsu curry, tempura soba, donburi, all about ¥800–1,100.

info.label: Tip
info.value: Last order early; phone first (irregular closed days)

tips: Arrive by 13:05: it closes at about 14:00.

places.blurb: An Osaka okonomiyaki chain restaurant on Dotonbori that stays open late: good after the Nara fire.
tips: You arrive about 21:25: order before 22:00.

tips: Walk to Ebisubashi bridge after dinner for the Glico sign photo.

tips: Walk through the Sanjo-meitengai arcade (the Sabbat scene) before or after lunch.

tips: Be at the door at 17:00: a queue forms fast.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安

places.ja: 満足食堂

info.label: Hours

tips: Backup: Yamamoto Shokudo (Fri 17:00–19:30), 5 min away.

places.ja: セイコーマート 永井店
places.blurb: A Seicomart 5 minutes on foot from the Sapporo hotel: a cheap breakfast instead of the ¥3,300 hotel buffet.
